subject: learning/installer-startup-signals
statement: Install the init signal handler before the first filesystem write, including execution-log directory setup, so an early SIGINT or SIGTERM follows cancellation instead of leaving partial startup state.
intent: Preserve interruption safety across installer startup and rollback.
rationale: Two pre-push runs failed when SIGTERM interrupted log-directory creation before the handler was registered. Moving the existing handler ahead of logger setup closes that gap while retaining second-interrupt behavior.
fit_criterion: A subprocess regression sends real SIGINT and SIGTERM at the first-write boundary, including a closed terminal; the existing installed-flow signal and retry test remains enabled and passes.
learned_from: TestInitHandlesSignalBeforeLogSetup fails with the old startup ordering and passes with the handler installed before logger setup.
TestSignalMidApplyEndsCleanEitherWay passed 20 consecutive runs after the fix.
